baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus genitive binds the tree noun to a name whose only supplied branch concerns taking matter into the mouth and throat.
baseline_models.mechanism: The woody producer and the terminal act of swallowing are compressed into one name. The tree is therefore not merely something that may later be eaten; ingestion is already latent in its identity.

activation_trace.role: A stemmed woody plant supplies the producer whose identity can extend from growth to what enters a body.
Swallowing, mouth-taking, and repulsive intake supply the tree-name's bodily endpoint.

changed_reading.before: A botanical entity bearing an opaque proper name.
changed_reading.after: A woody producer named from the act it will impose at the mouth and throat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tree root itself carries an interwoven-dispute branch, while the attached name carries swallowing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branching growth can be heard as tangled contention: claims cross, multiply, and harden into a structure whose terminal product is swallowed. This remains alongside the botanical reading rather than replacing it.

activation_trace.role: Entangled dispute and mixed speech provide the branching social process that grows into the focus noun.
Repulsive swallowing turns verbal entanglement into a consequence that must be bodily taken in.

changed_reading.before: A plant designated by species name.
changed_reading.after: A ramifying quarrel whose growth ends as compulsory ingestion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A branch of the tree root names the jaw-space and the opening of a mouth with a stick or bridle.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can carry an oral apparatus inside its plant word: branching wood does not simply supply food but opens the receiving aperture and advances the intake.

activation_trace.role: Jaw-space and mechanically opened mouth make the tree word an intake apparatus as well as a plant.
Forced or repulsive swallowing gives that opened mouth a directional destination in the throat.

changed_reading.before: A tree standing outside its eventual eater.
changed_reading.after: A branching implement at the jaw that helps compel its own swallowing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tree root includes interlaced wooden frames that hold, prop, or block.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tree can be carried as a built support structure whose function has inverted: instead of bearing or protecting a body, it supports a process of repulsive intake.

activation_trace.role: An interlaced wooden frame supplies a load-bearing or blocking architecture within the tree noun.
Repulsive intake redirects the frame from support toward bodily coercion.

changed_reading.before: An organic plant with no constructed function.
changed_reading.after: An anti-support: a wooden lattice that bears and channels an imposed intake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two branches of the tree root concern stock or lineage and an outsider or borrowed lot inserted among a stock not its own.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus tree can mark an alien accession to a lineage: something admitted among branches despite not belonging to their origin, with swallowing as the destiny attached to that insertion.

activation_trace.role: An outsider or borrowed lot among alien stock supplies the mechanism of anomalous insertion.
Stock, origin, and lineage give the inserted outsider a genealogical structure to enter.
Swallowing supplies the assigned outcome that distinguishes this alien stock.

changed_reading.before: A tree belonging to a named botanical kind.
changed_reading.after: A foreign stock or inserted lot whose distinguishing issue is forced intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context unfolds the compressed name as a physiological chain: tree becomes food, food is taken, matter boils inside, hot liquid supplies the thermal analogue, and tasting makes the process experiential. The focus names a self-executing ingestive furnace rather than a static object.

activation_trace.role: The stemmed plant is the material producer at the start of the chain.
Mouth-taking and swallowing provide the transfer from plant to body.
Tasting and consuming explicitly actualize the ingestive potential of the focus name.
A pot's surging boil supplies the transformation undergone after intake.
The inside of a thing localizes that boil within the eater.
Hot water supplies the liquid heat against which the internal boiling is measured.
Experiencing a thing turns the food process into an imposed state rather than a viewed spectacle.

structural_cues: The focus noun phrase receives its food predicate immediately in 44:44.
The sequence then moves without interruption from food to belly-boiling to hot liquid to tasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each material and bodily stage; I infer that they unpack one process already compressed in the focus name. A live alternative is that they are consecutive punishments without semantic retroaction on the name.

changed_reading.before: A named tree that may later serve as food.
changed_reading.after: A tree whose name encodes the whole route from growth through swallowing to internal thermal transformation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The eater's root carries lagging behind the good, while the next material carries both unhurried delay and molten residue. The tree's growth image lets repeated moral delay accumulate like a crop, then congeal into matter that the swallowing-name returns to its cultivator.

activation_trace.role: Organic growth supplies the accumulation model by which repeated delay becomes a crop.
Repulsive swallowing makes the accumulated crop return bodily to the one who grew it.
Slowness and falling behind the good supply the moral duration that accumulates.
Deliberateness and absence of haste echo the temporal lag at the material comparison.
Molten substances and residues convert accumulated delay into ingestible, heated matter.

structural_cues: The eater and molten comparison follow the focus in two successive ayat.
The same local sequence moves from agent-characterization to material state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two independent delay images and one residue image; I infer a congealing arrow from delayed good to grown material. The live alternative is that the temporal branches are inactive and only the ordinary molten comparison operates.

changed_reading.before: A pre-existing external plant assigned to a wrongdoer.
changed_reading.after: The accumulated growth of delayed good, solidified as a crop that its cultivator must swallow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Uncertainty intertwines alternatives, sharp disputation keeps them moving, and language gives them an oral channel. The focus tree's dispute branch then becomes the architecture of that speech, while its swallowing-name converts the speakers' verbal recursion into bodily experience.

activation_trace.role: Interwoven quarrel and mixed speech supply the branching form of the model.
Swallowing changes argumentative output into an input imposed on the body.
Two possibilities interpenetrating without settled certainty seed the entanglement.
Sharp verbal contest makes the earlier uncertainty an active recursive dispute.
Wavering movement from the split inventory lets verbal oscillation reappear as unstable matter.
Language and speech restore the oral domain after the material consequence has unfolded.

structural_cues: Doubt appears near the opening, disputation returns immediately after the tasting command, and language closes the surah.
The focus stands where a long argumentative sequence turns into food and bodily action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertainty, dispute, wavering, language, and swallowing; I infer a conversion from speech topology to bodily topology. The live alternative is that the discourse frame and food scene remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: A botanical object interrupting an argument.
changed_reading.after: The argument's own branching form, made material and fed back through the disputant's mouth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A wise or governed matter carries a bridle-bit branch; the focus tree carries jaw-space and mouth-opening by stick or bridle; food carries a throat-grip; violent dragging supplies enforcement. Together they activate the tree as an oral instrument executing judgment by compelling intake.

activation_trace.role: The jaw-space and mouth-opening implement provide the apparatus at the focus anchor.
Making matter reach the throat gives the apparatus its enforced operation.
A rein or bit joins governance and oral control in one concrete image.
A grip at the feeding-place during choking sharpens the mouth-throat coercion.
Violent hauling supplies the force that operates the imagined bridle rather than consent.

structural_cues: The early wise matter is followed later by a compact execution sequence of food, hauling, and tasting.
The focus root and the judgment root independently converge on bridle mechanics.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bridle or mouth-control images plus throat pressure and hauling; I infer that they compose one judicial apparatus. The materially live alternative is lexical coincidence across distant root branches.

changed_reading.before: A plant delivered as an item of punishment.
changed_reading.after: A judgment-bridle whose wood opens the mouth and makes the sentenced intake occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: Interlocked spears and a load-bearing wooden frame turn the tree into capture-and-delivery infrastructure. Seizure, arrest, violent hauling, and the center of an inflamed conflict extend the same geometry: body and food are each forced along a branching channel into a containing destination.

activation_trace.role: Interlocked spears and thrusting supply the tree's armed, catching branches.
A wooden frame that bears or blocks turns the armed branches into infrastructure.
Forced intake supplies a second containment path parallel to the body's forced transport.
Overpowering seizure introduces the capture phase of the lattice.
Arrest and confinement make the body's movement non-voluntary.
Dragging by force supplies transport through the imagined frame.
Raging war and death make the destination a center of violent engulfment.

structural_cues: The earlier great seizure is realized locally by two imperatives that take and drag a body toward a center.
The food enters the body just before the body is itself made to enter the fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capture, hauling, armed interlock, frame, and two inward movements; I infer one nested delivery mechanism. An alternative is a simple chronology in which plant, arrest, and destination have no shared geometry.

changed_reading.before: A stationary tree encountered as food.
changed_reading.after: A branching coercive lattice that catches, channels, and encloses both eater and eaten.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punishment root retains branches of sweetness, bodily abstention, and pain; fruit supplies delectable nourishment, while food supplies livelihood. The focus tree is therefore an inversion engine inside the category of nourishment: it is food that defeats feeding, makes palatability and refusal collide, and converts sustenance into pain.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary woody plant keeps the reading inside the domain of edible growth.
Repulsive swallowing makes intake occur despite the collapse of nourishment.
Sweetness and pleasant water or food preserve the positive pole being inverted.
A body's refusal of food and drink supplies anti-feeding from within the same root inventory.
Painful punishment supplies the realized negative pole.
Delectable fruit supplies the intact alternative form of arboreal nourishment.
Food as livelihood and good condition defines what the focus food fails to provide.

structural_cues: The focus is predicated as food, repeatedly surrounded by punishment language, then contrasted with freely requested fruit.
The two food scenes share ingestion vocabulary but reverse security and bodily outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the positive and negative nourishment poles; I infer that the focus tree actively reverses one into the other. The alternative is that the sweet and abstention branches remain dormant under the ordinary punishment sense.

changed_reading.before: A noxious food opposed to good food.
changed_reading.after: An anti-food that inhabits nourishment's own vocabulary and turns feeding, sweetness, and livelihood against the eater.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular named tree is answered by concealed gardens, flowing springs, delectable fruit, inward security, and active protection. The focus is no longer an isolated monstrous plant but the compressed counter-orchard: one growth organizes an entire ecology of forced intake just as the later plural garden organizes an ecology of free provision.

activation_trace.role: The singular stemmed plant provides the negative ecology's organizing growth.
Repulsive swallowing defines how provision circulates in that negative ecology.
Settled inner security supplies the opposite affective condition of eating.
A garden concealed by trees expands the positive side from one tree to a sheltered habitat.
Flowing water sources supply sustaining circulation rather than internal boiling.
Pleasant fruit supplies freely available arboreal yield.
Protection that repels harm seals the boundary of the positive food ecology.

structural_cues: A compact negative food sequence in 44:43-50 is immediately followed by a positive garden sequence in 44:51-57.
Singular tree and compelled taste oppose plural gardens, requested fruit, security, and protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent food habitats with reversed agency, fluids, and safety; I infer deliberate ecological counter-structure. The alternative is a general reward-punishment contrast without the focus tree organizing the first habitat.

changed_reading.before: One exceptional tree contrasted vaguely with paradise.
changed_reading.after: The organizing tree of a complete counter-orchard whose food, fluid, agency, and boundary invert the later gardens.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first removes patronal support, then excepts mercy; the focus tree can mean wooden support and lineage; the later hot liquid root also carries intimate kinship. The sequence activates an anti-kinship scaffold in which a material intimate replaces the human intimate who cannot help.

activation_trace.role: A wooden frame that supports or blocks supplies the material counterpart to failed social support.
Stock and lineage keep kinship visibly anchored in the focus tree.
Swallowing makes the replacement support invade rather than aid the body.
Kinship supplies the social bond latent in the mercy exception.
Affection, aid, and alliance define the support explicitly denied just before the focus.
Close kin or intimate relation lets the later liquid retain a social double.
Hot water realizes that double as a hostile material companion.

structural_cues: The no-helper statement and mercy exception immediately precede the focus.
The hot liquid follows within three ayat, allowing social and material relations to exchange places.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed alliance, kinship, support-frame, lineage, and the hot-liquid/intimate pair; I infer a replacement relation between social support and hostile material. The alternative is that the relational branches do not activate in this sequence.

changed_reading.before: A tree faced by an isolated eater.
changed_reading.after: An anti-kinship support: hostile stock and hot intimacy occupy the place where ally, kin, and aid have failed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus outsider-stock branch is echoed by lineage attached where it does not belong, a stranger entering another group, inherited succession, descent from an origin, and a food-root branch in which a graft takes. The tree becomes a moral genealogy produced by an alien graft that successfully joined and then fruited as compulsory intake.

activation_trace.role: The outsider or borrowed lot among foreign stock supplies the anomalous member.
Stock and origin make anomalous membership genealogical rather than merely spatial.
Swallowing is the fruit or consequence borne by the joined stock.
A lineage joined outside its proper place directly echoes the focus outsider-stock branch.
A stranger entering people not his own supplies the movement into alien stock.
Transfer from predecessor to successor gives the stock a temporal path.
Descent and attribution to an origin supply explicit lineage structure.
A branch accepting a graft supplies the botanical operation that makes alien membership productive.

structural_cues: Inheritance, descendants, and a demand for ancestors recur before the focus's genitive stock construction.
The immediate food predicate allows the accepted graft to be read by its eventual yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outsider membership, misplaced lineage, succession, origin, and accepted graft; I infer that these form one genealogical growth model. A live alternative is that each image remains local to an unrelated lexical branch.

changed_reading.before: A species naturally belonging to its own botanical line.
changed_reading.after: An alien graft admitted into a moral lineage until it bears the eater's compulsory fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context joins fixed record, separation, a container gathering lots, decisive partition, and gaming or allocation lots. Activated by the focus branches for a tree-shaped representation and a borrowed lot among alien lots, the tree becomes a branching allocation diagram whose terminal assignment is swallowing.

activation_trace.role: A tree-shaped image or pattern supplies the visible branching diagram.
A borrowed lot among lots not of its stock supplies one anomalous allocated outcome.
Swallowing supplies the terminal state written at the end of the anomalous branch.
A fixed inscription that obligates judgment or measure supplies recorded assignment.
Distinguishing one thing from another supplies the first branching operation.
A bundle that gathers lots supplies the physical collection from which assignment proceeds.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies the decisive resolution of the branching record.
Lots used in gaming and division reactivate the allocation image at the close.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a record and separated matter, names a day of separation just before the focus, and closes with the root whose inventory includes allocation lots.
The focus is a short genitive node between adjudication and realized outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, distinguishing, gathered lots, final partition, and a tree-shaped or borrowed-lot image; I infer a decision-tree relation and assign swallowing to one terminal. The alternative is that the lot branches are form-distant accidents with no diagrammatic force.

changed_reading.before: A physical tree appearing after the day of decision is announced.
changed_reading.after: A tree-shaped allocation trace in which a recorded, separated lot terminates as compulsory swallowing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines form-distant branches for a tree-eating pest, a wood-eating termite, and sawing wood, then reverses agency when the eaten tree harms its eater. It remains anchored in the focus's literal woody plant and swallowing-name, reinforced by the immediate food predicate. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological predator-prey analogy, not as identification of any creature or tool in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The literal tree is made food, while several context inventories independently picture agents or tools that consume wood.

activation_trace.role: The woody plant supplies the edible substrate shared by the ecological images.
Swallowing establishes consumption, then permits the consumed tree to act back from within.
A pest that eats trees casts the excessive consumer as an ecological tree-eater.
Sawing wood adds deliberate cutting and consumption of tree-material.
A termite that eats wood supplies a second independent decomposer relation.

changed_reading.before: The eater consumes a passive tree-food.
changed_reading.after: A tree-eating consumer takes in apparent prey that reverses the relation and consumes the consumer from within.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the poison image comes from a non-dominant mapped inventory under the context sky root. It remains valid packet material and is anchored by the focus swallowing branch plus the nearby smoke and later boiling. Downstream prose must label it a split-root activation and must not gloss the contextual sky word itself as poison.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tree-name's swallowing mechanism can carry an externally arriving substance into the body.

activation_trace.role: The plant supplies a material carrier between environment and eater.
Swallowing provides the route by which the carried substance enters the body.
Poison entering a body supplies the hidden toxic payload from the split inventory.
Smoke rising from fuel supplies the visible environmental carrier.
Boiling completes the transfer as an internal toxic reaction.

changed_reading.before: A locally encountered plant that injures by being eaten.
changed_reading.after: A plant-conduit linking an enveloping atmospheric sign to poison delivered and activated inside the eater.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads separated bodily actions as one tree-shaped spatial circuit. It remains anchored in the stemmed plant, wooden frame, swallowing, belly interior, and explicit head-above-pouring sequence. Downstream prose should call it an anatomical analogy and preserve the alternative that these are merely successive actions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Stem, frame, and swallowing allow the tree to be projected onto the eater's vertical mouth-to-belly axis.

activation_trace.role: A stemmed plant supplies the vertical axis and crown-to-root geometry.
An interlaced frame lets the axis become a body-scale containing structure.
Swallowing establishes downward flow through the center of that structure.
The body's interior supplies the lower reservoir in which the swallowed matter changes.
Pouring supplies a second directed flow along the axis.
The upper direction fixes the source of the second flow above the body's crown.
The head and highest point make the eater's anatomy coincide with tree-top geometry.

changed_reading.before: A tree outside a body, followed by unrelated bodily torments.
changed_reading.after: An inverted body-tree whose crown, central conduit, and inner reservoir organize downward ingestion and pouring from above.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the vine image is a distant branch activated by an honorific adjective in an ironic tasting command. It remains anchored through the focus's literal tree, the commanded taste, and the later delectable fruit. Downstream prose should frame it as an ironic horticultural counter-image, not as a claim that the focus plant is botanically a vine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A named tree is followed by tasting and an honor term whose inventory includes the cultivated vine.

activation_trace.role: The literal woody plant provides the horticultural base for the counter-image.
Repulsive swallowing turns cultivation's expected pleasure into imposed intake.
Honor and praised generosity supply the status pole targeted by the command's irony.
Grapes and vine supply a cultivated edible plant as the tree's ironic double.
Tasting makes the claimed honor answerable to the actual yield of its plant.
Delectable fruit supplies the non-ironic cultivated yield that follows in the counter-scene.

changed_reading.before: A grotesque tree followed by a separate taunt about honor.
changed_reading.after: An anti-vine whose tasted yield tests and overturns the eater's claim to cultivated honor.

strongest_changes: The proper name became a compressed process: growth, mouth-taking, swallowing, internal boiling, and experienced state.
The tree's dispute branch let the surah's doubt and disputation become bodily rather than remain verbal.
Jaw, bridle, spear, frame, seizure, and hauling kept a coercive-apparatus reading alive beside the botanical one.
The later secure gardens revised the focus into a complete counter-orchard rather than one isolated bad plant.
Outsider-stock, graft, lineage, record, separation, and lots supported distinct genealogical and allocative readings without collapsing them together.
summary.what_was_special: Two focus roots opened unusually different domains: organism, dispute, weapon, support, jaw, representation, outsider, stock, and swallowing. Context did not merely decorate them; it supplied causal sequences that made several of those domains operational at once.
remaining_uncertainties: The jaw, borrowed-lot, graft, and vine readings are root-anchored but form-distant and need explicit qualification in prose.
The poisoned-sky model depends on a legitimate non-dominant mapping and must not be mistaken for a lexical gloss of the contextual sky word.
Several causal arrows join successive images that the packet may instead intend as juxtaposed stages.
The literal tree, dispute-growth, anti-support, genealogy, and allocation models remain coexisting readings; the packet does not force a final choice among them.
